instruction: Configure VLC to restrict its top volume level to 200% to safeguard hearing.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the maximum volume setting in VLC to 200%. The evaluator uses existing check_qt_max_volume metric to verify the vlcrc config file has qt-max-volume=200. Default value is 125, so user must navigate to VLC preferences and change it to 200.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to cap VLC maximum volume at 200%
Getter (get_vlc_config) extracts the correct state: VLC configuration file (vlcrc)
Metric (check_qt_max_volume) correctly parses vlcrc file and checks qt-max-volume setting
Metric correctly handles parameter: receives rules dict directly and accesses 'expected_qt_max_volume' without incorrect 'rules' nesting
Expected value (200) is semantically correct and matches instruction requirement
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config is loaded and can be verified
String comparison logic is correct: config values are strings, metric converts int to string
Default value handling is correct: metric sets default to '125' which matches VLC's actual default
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (set max volume to 200%) and evaluator checks exactly that
